bounded_question: Which neutral square deployment envelope, if any, allows exact immutable C0 Threshold K to function as a design-master app icon across compact scales and accessibility modes without changing C0 geometry or claiming shipping authority?

local_result.summary: All three envelopes pass mechanics; frozen Design Sol scoring leaves E06 as the sole survivor.

judgment.design_sol_view: E06 is the only envelope that balances micro identity recovery with sufficient square-field breathing room.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: No Director adjudication required because the frozen method reserves that gate for multiple materially viable survivors.

requires: later native/package/productization authority before shipping asset implementation
constrains: future app-icon design-master use of exact C0

Do not use color/material/platform masking to rescue or redefine identity.
If later platform packaging imposes masks/safe zones, treat that as implementation evidence against this design master rather than retroactive APPICON-01 tuning.
explicit_non_authority: No final shared identity or production symbol/vector authority.
No CLR, Stage, Character-art, product-semantic or Phase-D authority.
